token.title: 🔑 GitHub token
token.intro: GitHub gye abisadeɛ 60 dɔnhwerew biara ma address a ɛmmfa token mma. Fork dua a ɛyɛ mũ no bɛfa bɛyɛ 32, enti nsrahwɛ a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, ɛsa. Token ma anohyeto no kɔ 5000 dɔnhwerew biara.
token.step1: Bue Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, na afei Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: w'ankasa wo akawnt. Expiration: da biara, dua no nhia biribi a ɛtena hɔ kyɛ.
token.step4: Mfa wo nsa nka kwan biara. Ɔmanfoɔ akorae ho nsɛm nhia wɔn mu biara.
token.step5: Yɛ, na afei fa {token} boɔ no kɔpi. GitHub kyerɛ no prɛko pɛ.
token.classic: Token dada nso yɛ adwuma: yɛ no a wompaw kwan biara. Kwan hunu mpo kenkan ɔmanfoɔ nsɛm wɔ ntɛmpɛ a wɔagye atom so.
token.stays: Ɛtena browser yi mu wɔ safe {key} ase na ɛkɔ {host} nko ara. Wɔnkyerɛw no address no mu da, enti link a wode kyɛ no fa nhwɛbea no na ɛnfa ahintasɛm no. Button a ɛwɔ baabi no ase no pepa no bio ne cache no.
token.persistHow: Fa token no hyɛ {env} fael a ɛwɔ server a ɛkura krataafa yi so, {port} nkyɛn:
token.proxy: na fi ase wɔ {make}. Afei container no kyerɛw nginx asɛm ketewa bi a ɛde {header} header no ka {path} proxy ho, enti browser no frɛ n'ankasa fibea na ɛnnye token no da. Baabi yi yera na ahɔhoɔ nyinaa kyɛ dodoɔ baako a ɛyɛ 5000 dɔnhwerew biara.
fork.refused404: Nnubaa nsensanee biara nni hɔ: {message}. 404 wɔ ha yɛ dubaa a ɛnni hɔ anaa kwan a server proxy no mfa; fork ntontan a ɛwɔ soro no yɛ mũ biara.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub abisadeɛ asa wɔ dɔnhwerew yi mu, enti yɛantumi anhyehyɛ nnubaa nsensanee. Fork ntontan a ɛwɔ soro no yɛ mũ. Fa token ka yiyi panel no ho, anaa dum nnubaa nsensanee no wɔ nhyehyɛe panel no mu na dodoɔ no nkɔ ntontan no nko ara so.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub buaa {status} maa commit abakɔsɛm no, enti yɛantumi anhyehyɛ nnubaa nsensanee. Fork ntontan a ɛwɔ soro no yɛ mũ.
